subject: Clarify hosted usage tiers & model deltas — packaging proposal
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lo <emma@novaanalytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing questions — can we align on model deltas and commit bands?

Hi Emma — great to meet last week. Thanks again for the time and the product context. A quick follow-up with suggested structure so we can get you a simple purchase path for the POC and predictable run-rate if you scale.

High level ask: Nova is focused on chat-heavy usage (low-latency responses) and periodic large-batch embedding jobs for analytics. To make procurement easier, we want to propose a clear mapping: commit-tier (monthly token commit) + model category (standard vs premium) + usage type (chat vs embeddings).

Draft structure Im proposing (attached spreadsheet contains the full matrix):
- Commit bands (monthly): 0-500K tokens, 500K-2M, 2M-10M, 10M+
- Discounts at band start: 0%, 10%, 20%, 30% (applied to standard per-1K unit rates)
- Model delta: premium models = 1.9x standard per-unit price (applies after commit discount)
- Embeddings: priced per-1K vectors; category delta matches chat (premium multiplier)

Questions for procurement:
1) Do you prefer a single blended per-token price for all models under a commit, or separate lines for standard vs premium?
2) Any restrictions on burst/overage billing — e.g., should overage be billed at next-band list price vs a flat surcharge?

If youre ok, Ill pull together a short proposal with concrete numbers for the 3-month POC (expected 1.5M tokens/month chat + 100K embedding vectors/month).

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0139
From: Emma Lo <emma@novaanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing questions — can we align on model deltas and commit bands?

Marissa — thanks for the clear outline. A few quick answers from our side:
- Procurement prefers separate line items for standard vs premium models so budget owners can sign off against model families. Blended pricing is harder for our internal chargeback.
- For overage, we typically accept a flat 15% surcharge on the next-band list price rather than moving customers immediately into the next band. That keeps month-to-month predictability.

For the POC: we can commit to a 3-month pilot that looks like 1.5M tokens/mo chat + 100K embedding vectors/mo as you suggested. Wed like to see the per-1K numbers for standard vs premium (and the effective post-discount price at the 2M band), plus a one-line description of how embeddings are billed (per vector or per 1K tokens equivalent).

Looping in procure@novaanalytics.com once we have a formal quote.

—Emma
Emma Lo
VP Platform | NovaAnalytics
emma@novaanalytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: FW: NovaAnalytics pricing preferences — need final numbers for POC quote

Aditya / Karthik — forwarding Emmas response. Procurement wants model lines separated and an overage rule (Emma suggests 15% surcharge). Nova is comfortable with the 1.5M tokens/mo POC shape.

Can you confirm the following and share an internal-approved price sheet I can send to Emma tomorrow?
1) Standard chat list price per-1K tokens
2) Premium chat list price (or multiplier) and whether the 1.9x is acceptable
3) Embeddings pricing: per 1K vectors or per-token-equivalent — which aligns better with our billing pipeline?
4) Any minimum monthly commit we should require for discounts to apply (e.g., first-month pro-rate rules)

I attached a short scoring doc and the usage profile.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: NovaAnalytics pricing preferences — need final numbers for POC quote

Marissa — suggested headroom below (we should keep one discretionary concession for AE to approve a small uplift if they push). Numbers are list (pre-discount) and we apply commit-band discounts on top.

Proposed list pricing (per 1K tokens / per 1K vectors):
- Chat (standard): $0.012 per 1K tokens (list)
- Chat (premium): $0.023 per 1K tokens (list) — ~1.92x delta
- Embeddings (standard): $0.004 per 1K vectors (list)
- Embeddings (premium): $0.009 per 1K vectors (list) — ~2.25x delta (premium embedding models are heavier)

Commit discount table (monthly commit):
- 0–500K: 0%
- 500K–2M: 10%
- 2M–10M: 20%
- 10M+: 30%

Overage rule: bill at next-band list price + 15% surcharge (aligns with Emma's ask). We can also offer a monthly true-up option if they prefer blended invoicing — but procurement asked for separate lines so keep it simple.

Minimums: discounts apply only when the committed band is met in a billing month; for a multi-month commit we can offer pro-rated first month if they prepay 3 months.

Attachments: I exported a short "effective-prices" tab (will add to pricing pack).

—Aditya
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lo <emma@novaanalytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Procurement <procure@novaanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood — NovaAnalytics POC pricing proposal (3 months)

Emma / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is a concise quote and the pricing matrix (redwood-hosted-pricing-aug2026.xlsx). Key points:
- POC shape (monthly): 1.5M tokens chat (expected 80% standard / 20% premium model split), 100K embedding vectors (standard)
- Applied discount: 10% (band 500K–2M) to standard lines
- Effective prices (post-discount):
  - Chat standard (effective): $0.0108 per 1K tokens
  - Chat premium (effective): $0.0207 per 1K tokens
  - Embeddings standard (effective): $0.0036 per 1K vectors
- Premium model surcharge is a separate line item (Nova requested separate lines)
- Overages: next-band list price + 15% surcharge
- Term: 3 months POC; early termination allowed with 30 days notice; pro-rate for first month if prepaid.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/XYZ-Redwood-Nova-PoC (one-page quote + SOW)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DL-2026-449

Next steps:
1) Procurement to review and confirm if separate premium/standard lines are acceptable (or if they want example invoice).
2) If cleared, we send DocuSign and schedule a kickoff for the POC on Aug 24.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk the matrix.

Best — Marissa

Attachments: redwood-hosted-pricing-aug2026.xlsx, nova-pricing-workbook.pdf
From: Emma Lo <emma@novaanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@novaanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Redwood — NovaAnalytics POC pricing proposal (3 months)

Marissa — this looks good and concise. A couple of clarifications before we route to procurement:
1) For embeddings: wed like confirmation that "per 1K vectors" maps to our export shape (we send 100K vectors = billed as 100 x 1K units). OK?
2) For premium chat: can you confirm whether the premium multiplier applies to latency-optimized variants as well (we might use the premium model with lower context window for latency reasons). Does premium rate apply regardless of context window?

If you can add 1–2 sentences answering the two bullets Ill send this to procurement and aim to sign the DocuSign by the end of the week.

Thanks — Emma
